apps.desc: Waterfox is a fast, privacy-focused web browser based on Firefox, designed to preserve user choice and privacy.

apps.name: WhatsApp Desktop
apps.desc: WhatsApp Desktop is the official Windows desktop messaging app from Meta, distributed through the Microsoft Store.

apps.name: UniGetUI
apps.desc: UniGetUI is a GUI for WinGet, Chocolatey, and other Windows CLI package managers.

apps.name: WinRAR
apps.desc: WinRAR is a powerful archive manager that allows you to create, manage, and extract compressed files.

apps.name: WinSCP
apps.desc: WinSCP is a popular open-source SFTP, FTP, and SCP client for Windows. It allows secure file transfers between a local and a remote computer.

apps.name: WireGuard
apps.desc: WireGuard is a fast and modern VPN (Virtual Private Network) protocol. It aims to be simpler and more efficient than other VPN protocols, providing secure and reliable connections.

apps.name: Wireshark
apps.desc: Wireshark is a widely-used open-source network protocol analyzer. It allows users to capture and analyze network traffic in real-time, providing detailed insights into network activities.

apps.name: WizTree
apps.desc: WizTree is a fast disk space analyzer that helps you quickly find the files and folders consuming the most space on your hard drive.

apps.name: HxD Hex Editor
apps.desc: HxD is a free hex editor that allows you to edit, view, search, and analyze binary files.

apps.name: Xournal++
apps.desc: Xournal++ is an open-source handwriting notetaking software with PDF annotation capabilities.

apps.name: Yarn
apps.desc: Yarn is a fast, reliable, and secure dependency management tool for JavaScript projects.

apps.name: Zoom
apps.desc: Zoom is a popular video conferencing and web conferencing service for online meetings, webinars, and collaborative projects.

apps.name: uv
apps.desc: uv is a fast Python package and project manager written in Rust.

apps.name: TightVNC
apps.desc: TightVNC is a free and open-source remote desktop software that lets you access and control a computer over the network. With its intuitive interface, you can interact with the remote screen as if you were sitting in front of it. You can open files, launch applications, and perform other actions on the remote desktop almost as if you were physically there.

apps.name: GlazeWM
apps.desc: GlazeWM is a tiling window manager for Windows inspired by i3 and Polybar.

apps.name: Overwolf
apps.desc: Popular platform for game overlays and companion apps (mod managers, trackers, etc.), widely used by gamers.

apps.name: OFGB (Oh Frick Go Back)
apps.desc: GUI Tool to remove ads from various places around Windows 11

apps.name: Zen Browser
apps.desc: The modern, privacy-focused, performance-driven browser built on Firefox.

apps.name: Zed
apps.desc: Zed is a modern, high-performance code editor designed from the ground up for speed and collaboration.

apps.name: Zotero
apps.desc: Zotero is a free, easy-to-use tool to help you collect, organize, cite, and share your research materials.

apps.name: Deskflow
apps.desc: Deskflow is a free and open-source software KVM that lets you share a single keyboard and mouse across multiple computers.

apps.name: Ruby
apps.desc: A Ruby language execution environment with a MSYS2 installation.

apps.name: Lua
apps.desc: A 'batteries included environment' for the Lua scripting language on Windows.

tweaks.name: Activity History - Disable
tweaks.desc: Erases recent docs, clipboard, and run history.

tweaks.name: Hibernation - Disable
tweaks.desc: Hibernation is really meant for laptops as it saves what's in memory before turning the PC off. It really should never be used.

tweaks.name: Widgets - Remove
tweaks.desc: Removes the annoying widgets in the bottom left of the Taskbar.

tweaks.name: Start Menu Previous Layout - Enable
tweaks.desc: Bring back the old Start Menu layout from before the gradual rollout of the new one in 25H2. On newer versions of Windows !!THIS TWEAK WILL NOT WORK!!

tweaks.name: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable
tweaks.desc: Will not display recommended Microsoft Store apps when searching for apps in the Start menu.

tweaks.name: Location Tracking - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables Location Tracking.

tweaks.name: Services - Set to Manual
tweaks.desc: Sets some services to Manual startup and adjusts the SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB registry value to better match system memory, which can significantly reduce the number of svchost.exe processes.

tweaks.name: Brave Browser - Debloat
tweaks.desc: Disables various annoyances like Brave Rewards, Leo AI, Crypto Wallet and VPN.

tweaks.name: RDP Unsigned File Warnings - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables warnings shown when launching unsigned RDP files introduced with the latest Windows 10 and 11 updates.

tweaks.name: Microsoft Edge - Debloat
tweaks.desc: Disables various telemetry options, popups, and other annoyances in Edge.

tweaks.name: ConsumerFeatures - Disable
tweaks.desc: Stops promoted app installs and reduces app suggestions from Microsoft Store content.

tweaks.name: Telemetry - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables Microsoft Telemetry.

tweaks.name: Delivery Optimization - Disable
tweaks.desc: Stops Windows from using your bandwidth to upload updates to other PCs on the internet or local network.

tweaks.name: Microsoft Edge - Remove
tweaks.desc: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge by creating dummy MicrosoftEdge.exe file in the legacy Edge folder. This tricks Windows into unlocking the official Edge uninstaller allowing for a system-level removal.

tweaks.name: BitLocker - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables BitLocker.

tweaks.name: Date & Time - Set Time to UTC
tweaks.desc: Essential for computers that are dual booting. Fixes the time sync with Linux systems.

tweaks.name: Microsoft OneDrive - Remove
tweaks.desc: Denies permission to remove OneDrive user files, then uses its own uninstaller to remove it and restores the original permission afterward.

tweaks.name: File Explorer Home and Gallery - Disable
tweaks.desc: Removes the Home and Gallery from Explorer and sets This PC as default.

tweaks.name: Visual Effects - Set to Best Performance
tweaks.desc: Sets the system preferences to performance. You can do this manually with sysdm.cpl as well.

tweaks.name: Disable Reserved Storage
tweaks.desc: Disables Windows Reserved Storage (7-10 GB held for updates/temp files). Recommended only on small drives. Re-enable before major Windows feature updates to avoid installation failures.

tweaks.name: Restore Point - Create
tweaks.desc: Creates a restore point at runtime in case a revert is needed from WinUtil modifications.

tweaks.name: End Task With Right Click - Enable
tweaks.desc: Enables option to end task when right clicking a program in the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Storage Sense - Disable
tweaks.desc: Storage Sense deletes temp files automatically.

tweaks.name: Windows AI - Disable And Remove
tweaks.desc: Removes and disables all AI features/packages

tweaks.name: Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) - Disable
tweaks.desc: If enabled, WPBT allows your computer vendor to execute programs at boot time, such as anti-theft software, software drivers, as well as force install software without user consent. Poses potential security risk.

tweaks.name: Prevent Device Companion Apps
tweaks.desc: Prevents additional software from being installed when plugging in devices (e.g. Ads when plugging in a monitor). Poses potential security risk.

tweaks.name: Razer Software Auto-Install - Disable
tweaks.desc: Blocks ALL Razer Software installations. The hardware works fine without any software.

tweaks.name: System Tray Notifications & Calendar - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables all Notifications INCLUDING Calendar.

tweaks.name: Adobe URL Block List - Enable
tweaks.desc: Reduces user interruptions by selectively blocking connections to Adobe's activation and telemetry servers. Credit: Ruddernation-Designs

tweaks.name: Right-Click Menu Previous Layout - Enable
tweaks.desc: Restores the classic context menu when right-clicking in File Explorer, replacing the simplified Windows 11 version.

tweaks.name: Disk Cleanup - Run
tweaks.desc: Runs Disk Cleanup on Drive C: and removes old Windows Updates.

tweaks.name: Temporary Files - Remove
tweaks.desc: Erases TEMP Folders.

tweaks.name: IPv6 - Set IPv4 as Preferred
tweaks.desc: Setting the IPv4 preference can have latency and security benefits on private networks where IPv6 is not configured.

tweaks.name: Teredo - Disable
tweaks.desc: Teredo network tunneling is an IPv6 feature that can cause additional latency, but may cause problems with some games.

tweaks.name: IPv6 - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables IPv6.

tweaks.name: Background Apps - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables all Microsoft Store apps from running in the background, which has to be done individually since Windows 11.

tweaks.name: Fullscreen Optimizations - Disable
tweaks.desc: Disables FSO in all applications. NOTE: This will disable Color Management in Exclusive Fullscreen.

tweaks.name: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
tweaks.desc: Windows Explorer automatically tries to guess the type of the folder based on its contents, slowing down the browsing experience. WARNING! Will disable File Explorer grouping.

tweaks.name: BSoD Verbose Mode
tweaks.desc: Gives more information when you blue screen.

tweaks.name: System Tray Battery Percentage
tweaks.desc: Shows numeric battery percentage next to the battery icon in the system tray.

tweaks.name: Dark Theme for Windows
tweaks.desc: Dark Mode for the system and applications.

tweaks.name: File Explorer File Extensions
tweaks.desc: Shows .file extensions in Explorer (.exe, .png, etc.)

tweaks.name: File Explorer Hidden Files
tweaks.desc: Reveals hidden files in Explorer.

tweaks.name: Logon Verbose Mode
tweaks.desc: Show detailed messages during startup/shutdown.

tweaks.name: Microsoft Outlook New Version
tweaks.desc: This will ensures the classic Outlook application is used.

tweaks.name: Scrollbars Always Visible
tweaks.desc: If enabled, scrollbars will always be visible. If disabled, Windows will automatically hide scrollbars when not in use.

tweaks.name: Multiplane Overlay
tweaks.desc: Multiplane Overlay composes multiple image layers, which can sometimes cause issues with graphics cards. Changes to this preference are applied immediately.

tweaks.name: Mouse Acceleration
tweaks.desc: Makes it so Cursor movement is affected by the speed of your physical mouse movements.

tweaks.name: Num Lock on Startup
tweaks.desc: Toggle the Num Lock key state when your computer starts.

tweaks.name: Window Snapping
tweaks.desc: Toggles the window snapping feature when dragging windows.

tweaks.name: S0 Sleep Network Connectivity
tweaks.desc: Toggles network connectivity during S0 Sleep which is low power idle in modern laptops.

tweaks.name: S3 Sleep
tweaks.desc: Toggles between Modern Standby and S3 Sleep, which cuts off power to the CPU while continuing to refresh the memory.

tweaks.name: Settings Home Page
tweaks.desc: Toggles the Home Page in the Windows Settings app.

tweaks.name: Start Menu Bing Search
tweaks.desc: Toggles Bing web search results in Windows Search.

tweaks.name: Logon Screen Acrylic Blur
tweaks.desc: Toggles the acrylic blur effect on login screen background.

tweaks.name: Lock Screen - Disable
tweaks.desc: Skips the lock screen entirely and goes directly to the sign-in screen on boot and wake.

tweaks.name: Start Menu Recommendations
tweaks.desc: Toggles the recommendations section in the Start Menu. WARNING: This will also disable Windows Spotlight on your Lock Screen as a side effect.

tweaks.name: Sticky Keys
tweaks.desc: Toggles the Sticky Keys, which activate when clicking shift rapidly.

tweaks.name: Taskbar Centered Icons
tweaks.desc: Toggles the Taskbar alignment either to the left or center.

tweaks.name: Taskbar Search Icon
tweaks.desc: Toggles the Search Button on the Taskbar.

tweaks.name: Taskbar Task View Icon
tweaks.desc: Toggles the Task View Button in the Taskbar.

tweaks.name: Game Mode
tweaks.desc: Toggles Windows prioritizes gaming performance by allocating system resources to games.

tweaks.name: Enable Long Paths
tweaks.desc: Toggles support for file paths longer than 260 characters in Explorer.

features.name: .NET Framework (Versions 2, 3, 4) - Enable
features.desc: .NET and .NET Framework is a developer platform made up of tools, programming languages, and libraries for building many different types of applications.

features.name: NTP Server - Enable
features.desc: Replaces the default Windows NTP server (time.windows.com) with pool.ntp.org for improved time synchronization accuracy and reliability.

features.name: Hyper-V - Enable
features.desc: Hyper-V is a hardware virtualization product developed by Microsoft that allows users to create and manage virtual machines.

features.name: Legacy Media Components (WMP, DirectPlay) - Enable
features.desc: Enables legacy programs from previous versions of Windows.

features.name: Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) - Enable
features.desc: Windows Subsystem for Linux is an optional feature of Windows that allows Linux programs to run natively on Windows without the need for a separate virtual machine or dual booting.

features.name: Network File System (NFS) - Enable
features.desc: Network File System (NFS) is a mechanism for storing files on a network.

features.name: Registry Backup (Daily Task 12:30am) - Enable
features.desc: Enables daily registry backup, previously disabled by Microsoft in Windows 10 1803.

features.name: Legacy F8 Boot Recovery - Enable
features.desc: Enables Advanced Boot Options screen that lets you start Windows in advanced troubleshooting modes.

features.name: Legacy F8 Boot Recovery - Disable
features.desc: Disables Advanced Boot Options screen that lets you start Windows in advanced troubleshooting modes.

features.name: Windows Sandbox - Enable
features.desc: Windows Sandbox is a lightweight virtual machine that provides a temporary desktop environment to safely run applications and programs in isolation.
